About Me

Results-driven engineer who ships.

I'm a versatile AI/ML Engineer and Full-Stack Software Engineer with a Master's in Computer Science from Arizona State University and 6+ years of experience spanning the full spectrum: from data science and model development to production deployment and frontend delivery.

I'm currently a Senior Software Engineer at Lowe's, building React/TypeScript micro-frontends, leading CI/CD and testing strategy, and driving large-scale framework migrations. In parallel, at NetworkVC, I've architected serverless ML pipelines on AWS that cut infrastructure costs by 45%, sustained real-time inference at 10,000+ requests per second at sub-100ms latency, and kept systems running at 97%+ availability. I care deeply about systems that actually work in the real world, whether that's a model in production or a UI in front of a user.

I'm also available for freelance projects, whether you need AI/ML engineering, MLOps consulting, or full-stack software development. Let's build something great.
